newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Four dead and several missing after rain in Brazil.
newsitem.headline: Four dead and several missing after rain in Brazil.

text.p: Four people died and several were missing on Thursday after heavy rain caused flooding and damaged roads and bridges in southwestern Brazil, officials said.

One died and several disappeared after a 100-yard- (metre) long bridge was torn off its pylons and dragged downriver by floodwaters in the town of Eldorado, 143 miles (230 kms) south of Sao Paulo, a civil defence spokesman said. He said about 15 people standing on the bridge were able to pull themselves to safety but an unknown number were dragged away by the torrent.
Earlier in the day police said three people died in Parana state when three trucks fell into a huge crater that opened up when rain triggered a landslide beneath a highway.

The civil defence spokesman said 5,000 people were left homeless in Parana and Sao Paulo state by the torrential rains that have hit the region over the past four days. Heavy flooding and landslides are common in southern Brazil during the annual January and February rainy season.
